institution.name: Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine

qualifications: Bachelor's degree with at least Distinction or Second Upper Class Honours (or equivalent), or an MBBS
Confirmation from a proposed supervisor; choose a project from the PhD Project Proposals list
TOEFL iBT 100 or IELTS 6.5 (results within two years) where required
CV, one-page personal statement and one-page project proposal; S$50 application fee via the NTU Graduate Admissions Portal
description_short: NTU's Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine accepts PhD by Research applications for the August 2027 intake from 1 October to 31 December 2026, with outcomes by June 2027. Applicants choose a project and need a proposed supervisor's confirmation.
